description: Matthew Barbee and the listed United States mapping agencies publish a hydro-enforced digital elevation model for Oahu, Hawaiʻi. The January 2025 release has two-metre cells and is freely downloadable as a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The describing paper identifies coastal lidar surveys from 2007–2013, gap filling and adjustments that connect streams and water bodies towards the ocean. This terrain can support coastal inundation and infrastructure-exposure simulations. Upland areas received less attention than the low coastal plain, and the raster format inside the archive was not inspected. Vertical-datum handling and local elevation uncertainty require checking before engineering use. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this product. The ZIP was not downloaded, and the paper’s inundation results were not reproduced.
